skills.name: context-budget
skills.description: Keep model-visible context small and recoverable on long or output-heavy tasks through summaries before bodies, bounded reads, projection, artifact handles, evidence preservation, resume notes and concise answers. Use when output volume, rereads or compaction threaten the task; not for choosing or sequencing tool calls.

skills.name: repository-orientation
skills.description: Establish the relevant instructions, source boundaries and evidence for an unfamiliar repository or repository status assessment. Use before substantial investigation; not for every small edit.

skills.name: test-contract-freshness
skills.description: Investigate passing tests that may use stale mocks, fixtures or interfaces. Use for test-validity audits and narrow freshness guards; not for ordinary test execution.

skills.name: tool-call-discipline
skills.description: Plan, sequence and recover multi-step tool calls by choosing an engine per question and corpus, batching independent reads, serializing mutations against expected state, paging completely and handling failures or uncertain outcomes. Use when several calls depend on each other or a call failed; not for one known read or for output size alone.

skills.name: verified-change
skills.description: Select and run proportionate repository checks for an implemented change and report their evidence and limits. Use when completing a change; not for investigating whether test doubles have drifted.
